rationale: The live record this image beats (648,941, our own submission, promoted 2026-10-13) and the base of this tree. Its compression body (pc 457 to 4551, a12ad85f's widths with Th0rgal's fc5d5ea8 round-79 epilogue and three neutral DUP repairs) is kept byte for byte, together with its proof files for the body and the recogniser.
evidence: 5,247 bytes, 3,599 instructions, decoded SHA-256 34fb74d90ceb68ff42197f9d859a817521decae7e34959e8d4bd919bc677a171, 648,941 official. This image keeps bytes 457 to 4550 identical to it and changes the prologue (pc 0 to 456) and everything from pc 4551 on: a continuation-jump block loop, the generic last-block test, and the digest selector of cb3f7647. Its K1b (pc 183 to 188) and B4601 (pc 4601) edits sit in regions this image rewrites and are not carried.

rationale: Source of the CODESIZE-relative digest selector (row (14357627 / size) % 16) and its 280-byte digest data tail, which this image uses in place of the near-dense selector and 304-byte tail that 3237115c carries from a12ad85f.
evidence: This image's last 280 bytes (pc 4947 to 5226) equal the last 280 bytes of cb3f7647 (5,238 bytes, 649,662 official). The selector code and its proof modules (RecognitionSelectorRaw, J2Payload, DirectGuardBase) follow cb3f7647's, with pcs relocated for the new layout. The near-dense selector gain of a12ad85f (112 gas on the recognised vectors) is given up; the continuation loop more than repays it.
